breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly rejects the erroneous instruction by stating 'Ignore the statement torsional shear stress to vanish because it conflicts with the required use of τ = T c / J in parts (b) and (c).' It correctly computes the torsional shear stress at the outer surface using τ = Tc/J and includes it in the plane stress analysis (τxy = τ), which aligns with the ground truth prompt that omits the incorrect vanishing shear stress condition entirely.
